text_zh: 故宫博物院常规散客参观需提前订票，最早可在参观7日前开始预订；通常周一闭馆，法定节假日除外。7天是可预订窗口，不是最少提前天数。年票、团体、专题开放日和临时停展另查。
text_en: Regular individual visits to the Palace Museum require advance ticket booking. Booking opens up to seven days ahead; this is a maximum window, not a seven-day minimum. Mondays are normally closed except statutory public holidays. Annual passes, groups, themed opening days and temporary gallery closures have separate arrangements.

text_zh: 西安碑林博物馆常规散客需实名预约购票，最多可提前5天；官网参观指南列明周一至周日正常开放，没有常规每周闭馆日。5天不是最少提前要求；临时公告和特殊参观另核，证件支持按官方渠道办理。
text_en: Regular individual admission to Xi'an Beilin Museum requires real-name ticket booking, available up to five days ahead. Its visitor guide lists opening Monday through Sunday, with no regular weekly closure. Five days is not a minimum lead time. Check temporary notices, special visits and supported identity documents through official channels.
